question: Where is café positioned within 110 kilometers when moving from Smithfield Community Park, Smithfield, NC toward Wakemed Heart Center, Raleigh, NC?
sql: WITH locations AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Smithfield Community Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Smithfield%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1) AS start_point, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Wakemed Heart Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Raleigh%' LIMIT 1) AS end_point ) SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city FROM pois, locations WHERE pois.amenity = 'cafe' AND locations.start_point IS NOT NULL AND locations.end_point IS NOT NULL -- Filter for cafes within 110 kilometers straight-line distance from the starting point AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, locations.start_point::geography, 110000) -- Filter for cafes that are "on the way" by being within a 5km buffer of the direct line segment -- connecting the start and end points. AND ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(locations.start_point, locations.end_point)::geography, 5000)::geography);
